caseNameFull: City of Los Angeles v. Lyons

opinions.text: C. A. 9th Cir. [Certiorari granted, 455 U. S. 937.] Motion of respondent to dismiss writ of certiorari as improvidently granted denied. Further consideration of the memorandum of petitioner suggesting a question of mootness and addressing related issues is deferred to hearing of case on the merits.
